experiences.label: Try it
experiences.summary: Use focused Agent Plugins and ESS to turn one feature idea into a validated system model, deterministic docs, and a scoped, critic-reviewed plan with visible blockers.

adoptionPaths.label: Plan one governed change with Claude
prerequisites: The pinned AEP and ESS command-line binaries on PATH for a supported Linux or macOS target
adoptionPaths.outcome: Finish with a validated ESS model and generated docs, a scoped and critic-reviewed plan, and explicit blocker and evidence records; driven implementation remains optional and experimental.

experiences.label: Learn
experiences.summary: Build a practical mental model for agentic coding without starting from tools, repositories, or infrastructure.

adoptionPaths.label: Understand safe autonomous coding
adoptionPaths.outcome: Explain the boundaries between evidence, governed work, executable intent, agent execution, and external effects.

experiences.label: Build
experiences.summary: Move from focused Claude guidance to provider-neutral loops, controlled execution, and outside-in evaluation.

adoptionPaths.label: Build observable agent systems
adoptionPaths.outcome: Choose the smallest agent-system layer that owns the execution or evaluation need.

experiences.label: Evaluate
experiences.summary: Review what a product can demonstrate publicly without turning source visibility into a deployment promise.

adoptionPaths.label: Review Devcenter without credentials
prerequisites: Node.js and pnpm to run the credential-free frontend review locally
adoptionPaths.outcome: Run or inspect the credential-free frontend review and understand its license and production-access boundaries.
adoptionPaths.note: The public source is licensed for a trial of less than 32 consecutive calendar days for one application. It does not grant production use or image access.

adoptionPaths.label: Build the full Devcenter service from source
prerequisites: Approved GitHub access to the private sibling dependencies
adoptionPaths.outcome: Build and run the full service container locally after obtaining access to every private build dependency.
adoptionPaths.note: This is an approved evaluation path, not a public binary distribution or a production-use grant.

experiences.label: Operate
experiences.summary: Find service operations material without pushing cluster and chart detail into the practitioner onboarding path.

adoptionPaths.label: Deploy and operate an available service
adoptionPaths.outcome: Reach the owning service's deployment and operations contract with its access limitations intact.

adoptionPaths.label: Deploy Devcenter to a company cluster
prerequisites: Approved access to the production Devcenter image
adoptionPaths.outcome: Confirm the private production-image boundary before committing to a company-cluster deployment.
adoptionPaths.note: The public chart is insufficient on its own, and the required production image is unpublished and private. This path is paused; review the operator documentation, then wait for an explicit distribution, license, and access contract.

experiences.label: Contribute
experiences.summary: Work from repository authority, exact source revisions, and the canonical Website projection.

adoptionPaths.label: Contribute to or maintain the documentation system
prerequisites: Access to the repository that owns the claim
adoptionPaths.outcome: Change source-owned documentation and verify its canonical projection without creating another public documentation site.
